events.name: Bash
events.head: View last commit diff and admin routes
events.input: $ git diff 526e5b9~1 526e5b9 | head -40; grep -n '"/api/admin[^"]*"' cloud/src/index.ts | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin API routes
events.input: $ grep -n 'p === "/admin/api[^"]*"\|path === "/api[^"]*"\|"/admin/api/[a-z/-]*"' cloud/src/*.ts | head -40; ls ~/.config/tantra/ | head; grep -n 'calendarStatus' cloud/src/*.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read calendar status route and auth
events.input: $ sed -n 735,760p cloud/src/index.ts; grep -n 'path === "/admin/api/attendees\|"/admin/api/attendees' cloud/src/index.ts | head -5; grep -n 'isAdmin' cloud/src/index.ts | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check admin auth header
events.input: $ sed -n 60,88p cloud/src/index.ts | grep -n 'header\|cookie\|key' | head; grep -n 'res === "attendees"' cloud/src/index.ts | head -3

events.text: I'm checking production read-only: Invite Status and the attendee rows for the test and placeholder addresses.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read production invite status and attendee rows
events.input: $ cd /tmp && K=$(cat ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key) && B=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev && curl -s -c /tmp/t227j -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "$B/admin/enter?k=$K" && curl -s -b /tmp/t227j "$B/admin/api/calendar" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(json.dumps(d)[:900])"; curl -s -b /tmp/t227j "$B/admin/api/attendees" | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Sign in and read production status
events.input: $ K=$(cat ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key) && B=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev && curl -s -c /tmp/t227j -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST --data-urlencode "token=$K" "$B/admin/enter" && curl -s -b /tmp/t227j "$B/admin/api/calendar" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(json.dumps(d)[:1200])"; curl -s -b /tmp/t227j "$B/admin/api/attendees" | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check status reason fields and registrant routes
events.input: $ curl -s -b /tmp/t227j "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/api/calendar" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);g=d['google'];print(sorted(d.keys()), sorted(g.keys()));print({k:v for k,v in d.items() if k not in('google','zoom')})" | head -c 1500; echo; grep -n 'registrants' cloud/src/*.ts | grep -v '^\s*//' | head -15
